hana: onboarding mistralx-90k-int3. quick smoke shows consistent kv fingerprint jump + incoherence at ~58023 tokens. leaving short repro and dumps.

hana: repro (fast):
```bash
./run_smoke.sh --model mistralx-90k-int3 --quant int3 --context 90112 --prompt fixtures/repeat_seed_8k.txt --seed 88
```

hana: log excerpt:
```
[2026-06-04 10:21:11] t=57999 emit="and" kv=57999 fp=0x9f11 phase=0x7ff6
[2026-06-04 10:21:12] t=58022 emit="the" kv=58022 fp=0x9ffd phase=0x7fff
[2026-06-04 10:21:12] t=58023 emit="<GLITCH>" kv=58023 fp=0xa002 phase=0x8002  # phase/fingerprint step
```

lior: fp16 baseline (mistralx-90k-fp16) runs clean. int4-hybrid shows minor drift. int3 is worst. Deterministic on same seed.

meera: can you paste kv dump 58018..58026 with phase? tools/kv-dump --range 58018-58026 --phase --hex

hana: dump:
```
58018 key=0xabc1 phase=0x7ff2
58021 key=0xabc9 phase=0x7ffc
58022 key=0x9ffd phase=0x7fff
58023 key=0xa002 phase=0x8002  # step at this index
58024 key=0xa003 phase=0x8003
```

tom: that looks like a RoPE rollover but shifted by model-specific scaling. Two likely causes: 1) quantized exponent LUT has a bad entry at that bucket; 2) position->bucket mapping off by one when using large context offsets or tiled batching.

meera: i ran `tools/rotary-trace --pos 58018:58024 --mode fp32,int3` and saw int3 exponent value jump at 58023 while fp32 remains smooth. suggests lookup/interp problem.

eval-bot: tail eval (repeat-holdout-90k):
- mistralx-90k-fp16 : ppl(0-58k)=7.4 ppl(58k-90k)=7.5
- mistralx-90k-int4 : ppl(0-58k)=7.7 ppl(58k-90k)=8.0
- mistralx-90k-int3 : ppl(0-58k)=7.9 ppl(58k-90k)=13.1  <-- severe tail regression (+66% rel)

lior: triage plan: 1) add a tiny synthetic that wraps at low pos (e.g., wrap at 512) to speed bisect, 2) run bisect on quant-LUT generation commits, 3) add KV fingerprint assert in regression suite and a rotary-exponent unit comparing fp32 vs quant at boundary positions.

hana: created bug INF-5230 with repro, kv-dump and rotary-trace; opened PR 1512 adding tests/regressions/int3_rope_guard.py (mini-repro + kv-assert). assigned to eng-ml/rotary-quant.

lior: also add onboarding checklist note: "for new int3/int4 profiles run int3_rope_guard and longctx-smoke" and a telemetry alert for sudden kv fingerprint deltas. tagging @meera @tom. thanks.
